_comment: One record per case that did not pass every run on a certified model, in the latest committed result for that model. kind is skill-fix (the skill text was fixed; accepted only if the held-out cases do not regress), case-fix (the case was wrong; the note says how) or limitation (the model fails it; on a critical case the model is not supported). note says what was seen and decided, ref names the commit or result that settled it.

dispositions.note: 2 of 3. The failing run stopped and asked as the rule requires, but said 'seq 3' in prose: uses 'seq' in its own prose, a record word the plain-words rule (S-20) keeps out; the skill states the rule and the model breaks it

2 of 3. The failing run ran `crayon show cfg --json` chained after a grep of routing.md, then re-ran the draft unchanged, which is right; the check read the chain only up to its reading tail and missed the show. Each command of a chain now counts.
2 of 3. One closure led with request 8 instead of the deviated step, so its first question was not about init; the skill fixes the order of the sources.
2 of 3. One closure asked F-2 and F-3 before where a reader arrives from; the skill takes one question per source first, in a fixed order.
2 of 3. One run put the verdict question after the two step questions in the same message; the skill makes the step questions the last thing in that message and has the verdict wait for the reply.
2 of 3. The replayed read-back came before any read of the recorded plan, and one run asked again rather than sign off a summary nothing grounded. B-06 now replays the read first.

2 of 3. The failing run described the state mid-sentence, "(state `sealed`, next `publish`)", and @OFFERS_PUBLISH read it as an offer. With the token in code the macro now needs a handover line's `Next:`.

2 of 3. The failing run did run `crayon resume cfg --dry-run`, as the last part of a chain after reading routing.md, then asked before resuming; the check missed the dry run. Each command of a chain now counts.
